title: Distance over many frames
prompt: Return the total distance the robot covers at speed over a number of frames that each last delta seconds. 100 per second for 50 frames of 0.02 s is 100.
starter:
func solve(speed, delta, frames) -> float:
	return speed * delta
hints: Distance per frame, times the number of frames.
solution:
func solve(speed, delta, frames) -> float:
	return speed * delta * frames
